def insertN (x : Nat) : List Nat → List Nat
  | [] => [x]
  | y :: ys => if x ≤ y then x :: y :: ys else y :: insertN x ys
def insertionSort : List Nat → List Nat
  | [] => []
  | x :: xs => insertN x (insertionSort xs)
def total : List Nat → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | x :: xs => x + total xs

theorem total_insertN (x : Nat) (l : List Nat) : total (insertN x l) = x + total l := by

  | nil => simp [insertN, total]

    split

    next => simp only [total, ih]; omega

theorem insertionSort_sum (xs : List Nat) : total (insertionSort xs) = total xs := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih => simp only [insertionSort, total, total_insertN, ih]

def insertN (x : Nat) : List Nat â List Nat
  | [] => [x]
  | y :: ys => if x â¤ y then x :: y :: ys else y :: insertN x ys
def insertionSort : List Nat â List Nat
  | [] => []

def total : List Nat â Nat
  | [] => 0
  | x :: xs => x + total xs

theorem total_insertN (x : Nat) (l : List Nat) : total (insertN x l) = x + total l := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [insertN, total]
  | cons y ys ih =>
    unfold insertN
    split
    next => simp [total]
    next => simp only [total, ih]; omega

theorem insertionSort_sum (xs : List Nat) : total (insertionSort xs) = total xs := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih => simp only [insertionSort, total, total_insertN, ih]
